en: Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a large curved masonry dam and reservoir set in a green, wooded valley. People in early 20th‑century dress stand and walk along the dam parapet. In the foreground there is a grassy area and part of a stone building or pavilion with columns on the right. Printed French text appears along the bottom, and a web watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible over the image.
